name: Runner Extras - ReportExtension Unbound Report Behaviour
brief: Issues #4909 / #4918: the runner binds a reportextension's request page to the report but not yet its report triggers or data items. Running such a report must refuse by name rather than skip them. Runner-specific by construction: it asserts the runner's own refusal.
description: What BC does with the same objects (the request-page field is reachable, its OnValidate runs) is upstream in the al-language corpus, codeunit 67546. What stays here is only what the runner answers where it cannot yet do what BC does.
